# Crayon Roofing & Structures — Sales Call Knowledge Base (auto-distilled)

## Corpus summary

This corpus is a large mixed batch of call snippets (mostly very short, 10–40 seconds) from Crayon Roofing and Structures, a metal-roofing-sheet manufacturer/dealer located in Manali / Andarkuppam Check Post, Chennai (also referred to as "Manali New Town" / near MFL Road). The vast majority of calls are internal operational chatter — dispatch/vehicle coordination, driver pickup, production-floor queries, bill/e-way-bill handling, staff-leave issues, software/system troubleshooting, and finance/loan cold-calls received by the office (ignored per instructions).

Genuine **sales** calls that remain are: (1) outbound telecalling to cold leads asking "Roofing sheets JSW Steel requirement இருக்கா?", (2) inbound enquiries from fabricators/dealers/distributors/direct customers asking for rate, thickness, color, stock and delivery timelines, (3) a handful of price-negotiation/credit-term calls with existing dealers (Hindi/Tamil mixed, e.g., the long Abdul bhai distributor call), and (4) size/customization queries (L-flashing, bend/crimping sheets, PUF panels). There are relatively few calls that show a full sale cycle (enquiry → quote → PO/PI → payment → delivery); most are fragments of that cycle. This KB is built strictly from these fragments, so some sections (e.g., rates) are necessarily partial and some phrases repeat because the same scripts are used across calls.

## Products & brand ladder

Crayon deals in metal roofing/cladding and related accessories, sourced largely from **JSW Steel** brand lines, sold under several trade names depending on finish/price tier:

- **Color On Plus** — premium colour-coated roofing sheet (most frequently quoted brand)
- **Silver On** — galvanized/silver finish sheet, slightly pricier than plain, sold in 0.45–0.50mm
- **Radiance (JSW Radiance)** — another JSW colour-coated line
- **Pragathi / Pragathi Plus** — a lower-cost line ("JSW Pragathi")
- **Asian Indra Dhanush** — another brand line mentioned alongside Pragathi
- **Plain/non-colour GI sheet** — base/uncoated

**Thicknesses commonly quoted:** 0.40, 0.45, 0.47 (most common), 0.50, 0.6, 0.8 mm
**Colours mentioned:** off-white (most in-demand/fast-moving), sky blue, grey/pencil grey, graphite grey, cauliflower green, Nova blue, missed/mist green, brick red, traffic grey

**Other product lines surfacing in sales calls:**
- **PUF/PIR sandwich panels** — roof panel & wall panel, thickness 30/40/50mm (quoted ~₹1500 roof panel / ₹1450 wall panel, 50mm)
- **Decking sheets** (1.2mm enquiries, square-meter based)
- **Polycarbonate sheets / base plates** (with turbo fan accessory combos)
- **Tile profile sheets** (sample/colour matched, e.g. brick red)
- **L-flashing / rain water cutter / crimping (bend) sheets** — accessory fabrication, cut-to-size
- **Louvers** — custom-made on request ("company-ல பண்றாங்க, rate கேட்டு சொல்றேன்")
- **Screws** (Tata brand, 1 inch, sold by box/carton — 700 pcs/box, 7000/carton)
- **Cutting wheels** (4", 14"), **welding rods** (3.15mm), **nut-bolts** — hardware side-line
- **Square pipes** (various mm sizes, sold by weight/length)
- **Checkered plate (3mm GI)** — enquiry only, redirected to another contact

Standard sheet width is **3.5 ft / 1.08 meter**; length is cut-to-order up to ~30-35 ft; everything is invoiced in **square meter**, not running feet or per-sheet — a frequent point of customer confusion.

## Real rates & terms (only rates that actually appear in the calls)

- Color On Plus 0.47: **₹435 + GST** (one call), **₹445 + GST** (multiple calls, most common quote for off-white 0.47), **₹465 + GST** (after a price revision), also seen at **₹545 + GST** in one call (likely 0.47 miscue, corrected to 445)
- 0.50 thickness Color On Plus: **₹475 + GST**
- Pragathi: **₹405 + GST** (plain), **₹435 + GST** (with colour)
- Radiance: **₹113** per unit (context: distributor/coil pricing)
- Color On Plus (bulk/coil dealer price context): **₹118 + GST**, also quoted as low as **₹101 + GST (plain)** and **₹119 + GST (colour)** for Silver On in one call
- Silver On 0.47: **₹410 + GST** and **₹435 + GST** in different calls (price moves almost daily — "ஒரு வாட்டி போக போகுது")
- 0.8mm heavy sheet: **₹750 + GST per sq.m**
- PUF Roof panel 50mm: **₹1500/sq.m**; Wall panel 50mm: **₹1450/sq.m**
- L-flashing standard 12"x12": **₹650 + GST per piece**; custom sizes double the rate if full-sheet width used (e.g., 400mm x 400mm vs 300mm x 300mm doubles cost)
- Screws (Tata, 1"): **₹120/piece** standard, bulk orders sometimes at ₹130 depending on stock/scarcity
- Cutting wheel 4": **₹13+GST (~₹15)**; 14": **₹325** (bulk 50-carton gets extra discount)
- Welding rod (3.15mm): **₹336/packet incl. GST**, bulk 50 cartons → special discount

**Payment terms actually quoted:**
- **"50% advance, 50% before delivery"** — standard, stated explicitly in at least two calls
- **No credit terms accepted** — explicitly refused multiple times ("credit-ன்றது நம்ம இதுல accept பண்ண மாட்டோம்")
- Price validity is short — "1 day validity தான் price குடுத்தேன்" — rates can change same-day or next-day, causing repeated PO/PI mismatch disputes
- GST always added separately; billing/delivery address often needs separate GST numbers (GR Engineering vs L&T address case) — company insists correct GST on the **delivery address**, not just billing name
- Minimum order practicalities: small fabrication jobs (e.g., "2 sheets") sometimes declined — "2 piece-க்காக பண்ண முடியாது, அதுதான் எங்க procedure"
- Transport/freight: generally customer-arranged or added to bill ("Transport amount bill-ல add ஆகி வரும், GST-யோட வரும்")

## Objection Playbook

**"Price has increased since last time / rate not matching PO"**
> Rep response pattern: acknowledge honestly, do not argue — "rate increase ஆயிருக்கு sir", then offer to check with "Sir" (owner/manager) for possible small discount, but firmly refuse to honor old PO price once market has moved: "PO அனுப்புற அப்புறம் quotation
